originalTitle: Summer jobs bounce back in UK thanks to busy calendar of sport and music
summary: Industry tracker finds ‘exceptionally warm weather’ has helped boost job listings in hospitality and tourism sector
content: The summer job has staged a comeback this year thanks to the hot weather and a packed calendar of events such as the men’s football World Cup, new UK figures show. Recent months have seen a significant increase in seasonal hiring in sectors such as hospitality and tourism compared with summer 2025, said the Recruitment and Employment Confederation (REC), which runs a monthly labour market tracker. It said that this time last year “there was concern about the death of the great British summer job”, but added: “This is the summer when the seasonal summer jobs market started to come back. “Exceptionally warm weather and a busy calendar of sporting, music and cultural events … has helped boost demand for workers.” A dip in postings for summer jobs last year fuelled concerns that squeezed employers would continue to cut back on seasonal hiring, which has traditionally given young people their first experience of the world of work. However, this year there has been a double-digit rise in hospitality and tourism job advertisements over the summer period. But there was a slight dip in the number of active job postings and new job postings in July this year when compared with the previous month. Maxine Bligh, the REC’s chief membership and innovation officer, said: “It is not totally straightforward for young people to earn wages just yet, with many entry-level jobs still not bouncing back as much as we would like. “But there are undoubtedly more opportunities across hospitality, tourism and construction than last year.” She added that “the prospect of an Indian summer in much of the UK may mean many of these opportunities last longer than usual”. There were just under 1.67m active job postings in the UK in July this year, which is up 7.7% on a year earlier but a 2.6% drop from June.
chineseTitle: 由于体育和音乐活动繁忙，英国的暑期工作岗位有所回升
chineseSummary: 行业追踪发现“异常温暖的天气”有助于增加酒店和旅游业的职位列表
chineseContent: 英国最新数据显示，由于天气炎热，加上男足世界杯等赛事排得满满的，暑期工今年卷土重来。负责每月劳动力市场跟踪的招聘和就业联合会 (REC) 表示，与 2025 年夏季相比，最近几个月酒店和旅游业等行业的季节性招聘大幅增加。报告称，去年这个时候“人们对英国伟大的暑期工作的消亡感到担忧”，但补充道：“今年夏天，季节性暑期工作市场开始复苏。异常温暖的天气和繁忙的体育、音乐和文化活动……有助于增加对工人的需求。”去年暑期工作职位的减少引发了人们的担忧，即受到挤压的雇主将继续削减季节性招聘，而季节性招聘传统上是年轻人第一次接触工作世界的机会。然而，今年夏季酒店和旅游业的招聘广告出现了两位数的增长。但与上个月相比，今年 7 月份的活跃职位发布和新职位发布数量略有下降。 REC 首席会员兼创新官玛克辛·布莱 (Maxine Bligh) 表示：“对于年轻人来说，赚取工资还不是一件容易的事，许多入门级工作岗位的反弹幅度仍没有我们希望的那么大。 “但毫无疑问，酒店、旅游和建筑领域的机会比去年更多。”她补充说，“英国大部分地区即将迎来小阳春，这可能意味着其中许多机会的持续时间比平时更长”。今年 7 月，英国有近 167 万个活跃职位发布，同比增长 7.7%，但较去年同期下降 2.6%。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
